Caveat: this only adds the runtime piece (`androidx.profileinstaller:profileinstaller:1.4.1`) to `app/build.gradle.kts`. The profile itself is still missing. Generating one needs a `:baselineprofile` macrobenchmark module, which means changes to `settings.gradle.kts` and the root `build.gradle.kts`, and a `androidx.baselineprofile` plugin entry. I left those alone because you limited the change to the app file. I could not build, so the version 1.4.1 is unverified against the latest release.
